strengths: The revised ending fully repairs the verified freshness issue while preserving empathy for the new last-ranked student, removal of the exhibit annotation, forward ambition, and changed pressure.

Eli's tactical model grows organically from ordinary combat evidence into bounded anomaly tracking without violating the prohibition on experiments.
The Rusk sequence preserves moral residue: technical insight does not absolve Kade of choosing the audience over the training value.
